import base64, hashlib, io, pathlib, tempfile, zipfile, subprocess, sys, json
root = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise')
payload = base64.b64decode((root / 'private-lab-v2.zip.b64').read_text().strip(), validate=True)
digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
assert digest == '889b9af3f9cdd0411001322ff481ede0c98969b3d0c9bf9358f574cba4085ac8'
expected = {'preaggregate': (0, []), 'global-join': (1, ['multiple grants', 'same id across teams', 'absent grants']), 'distinct-sum': (1, ['same-value events'])}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)) as archive:
    entries = [name for name in archive.namelist() if pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).name == 'exercise.py']
    assert len(entries) == 1, entries
    script = pathlib.Path(directory) / 'exercise.py'
    script.write_bytes(archive.read(entries[0]))
    runs = {}
    for mode, (exit_code, failures) in expected.items():
        for args in ([mode], ['--query', mode], ['--mode', mode]):
            run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            if run.returncode == exit_code:
                try:
                    report = json.loads(run.stdout)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    continue
                if report.get('failures') == failures:
                    runs[mode] = (args, report['sqlite_version'], exit_code)
                    break
        assert mode in runs, (mode, run.returncode, run.stderr, run.stdout)
lines = ['# Private instructor evaluation / Évaluation privée pour le personnel enseignant', '', 'Archive SHA-256 `'+digest+'`', '', 'Standalone SQLite exercise produced by autonomous AI agents. Run the commands from the directory containing the extracted `exercise.py`. No MySQL run was performed.', '', 'Exercice autonome pour SQLite produit par des agents IA autonomes. Exécuter les commandes dans le dossier contenant `exercise.py` après extraction. Aucun essai sous MySQL.', '', '| Command / Commande | Observed exit / Code observé | SQLite |', '|---|---:|---|']
for mode, (args, version, exit_code) in runs.items():
    lines.append('| `python3 exercise.py '+' '.join(args)+'` | '+str(exit_code)+' | '+version+' |')
lines += ['', 'Pass the exercise when the learner explains why multiple grants multiply matching events, why team and identifier must both match, why absent grants exclude a result, and why two equal event amounts both count. The preaggregation mode must pass all fixture cases. The other modes intentionally exit 1 and show the affected cases.', '', 'Réussite lorsque la personne explique pourquoi plusieurs autorisations multiplient les événements correspondants, pourquoi l’équipe et l’identifiant doivent tous deux correspondre, pourquoi l’absence d’autorisation exclut un résultat et pourquoi deux événements de même montant doivent tous deux être comptés. Le mode de préagrégation doit réussir tous les cas. Les deux autres modes renvoient volontairement le code 1 et indiquent les cas touchés.', '', 'Internal evaluation copy. External sharing depends on confirmed redistribution authority and approval of the exact buyer draft.', 'Copie pour évaluation interne. Tout partage externe exige la confirmation du droit de redistribution et l’autorisation du texte exact destiné au prospect.']
out = root / 'instructor-evaluation-en-fr.md'
out.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

That supports a concrete instructor evaluation for the existing training prospect. The prospect teaches MySQL, so the offer is a standalone SQLite exercise on aggregation, with no MySQL compatibility claim.
